entry.description: `NDC.PushFormat` no longer throws when an argument fails to format, for example an object whose `ToString()` throws or a date the culture's calendar cannot represent. It pushes the same error text `ILog.InfoFormat` writes, so the `using` body still runs. A malformed format string and null arguments no longer throw either; a null format still does (ANT-2026-PZUYSLEY, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
